highlights: The editor and file comparison preserve mixed line endings. Local saves recheck the file before replacing it and preserve its access controls.
SSH and archive downloads check destination conflicts before transferring data. The hex viewer reuses verified archive data when you page through a file.
Archive cleanup checks each input before removing it. If a multi-file deletion stops partway through, the panes refresh so you can review the remaining items.
The embedded Bash terminal respects your shell history filters, and large folders on a Dirlume server load in pages.
